chapter: Opening and early years in Dallas
title: Never practised scales or used instruction books
summary: Smith never bought instruction books or practised scales, only worked out melodies and ideas.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: As far as getting technique on the instrument was concerned, would you buy instruction books...
When you used to practice, did you used to practice scales and all that kind of stuff?
So all you would do would be that you would try to get the melody...
And then think of ideas to implement(?).
You never did any of those scales and arpeggios and all that kind of stuff.
